text: By and Listen (1 min) As part of the deepened collaboration, Meta intends to increase the deployment of Nvidia infrastructure for next-generation AI agents. Benoit Tessier / Reuters Nvidia NVDA 2.39 % increase; up pointing triangle and Meta META -1.88 % decrease; down pointing triangle Platforms are expanding their partnership on the Facebook parent’s artificial-intelligence offering Muse, a move they said reflects demand for “useful” AI agents. As part of the deepened collaboration, Meta intends to increase the deployment of Nvidia infrastructure, including Vera Rubin and Vera central processing units, for next-generation AI agents, the companies said in a statement.
